queries.query: SELECT c.kkode AS customer_code, c.knama AS customer_name, COUNT(si.siid) AS total_invoice_open, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_current, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_1_30, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_31_60, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_61_90, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 90 THEN si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS aging_over_90, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding FROM m5_si AS si INNER JOIN m1_contact AS c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid AND c.kaktif = 1 WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND (si.sistatuslunas IS NULL OR si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS') AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 100

queries.query: SELECT YEARWEEK(pv.pvtgl, 3) AS yearweek_iso, DATE_SUB(DATE(pv.pvtgl), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pv.pvtgl) DAY) AS week_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.pvid) AS total_payment_voucher, SUM(pvd.jmlbayar) AS total_collection_amount FROM m5_pv AS pv INNER JOIN m5_pv_detail AS pvd ON pv.pvid = pvd.idpv WHERE pvd.sumber = 'SI' AND pv.pvtgl >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY YEARWEEK(pv.pvtgl, 3), DATE_SUB(DATE(pv.pvtgl), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pv.pvtgl) DAY) ORDER BY week_start_date ASC

queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS customer_kode, c.knama AS customer_nama, COALESCE(inv.total_penjualan_bersih, 0) AS total_penjualan_bersih, COALESCE(inv.total_diskon, 0) AS total_diskon, COALESCE(cost.total_biaya_invoice, 0) AS total_biaya_invoice, COALESCE(ret.total_retur, 0) AS total_retur, (COALESCE(inv.total_penjualan_bersih, 0) - COALESCE(cost.total_biaya_invoice, 0) - COALESCE(ret.total_retur, 0)) AS margin_bersih FROM m1_contact c INNER JOIN ( SELECT si.sicustomer AS customer_id, SUM((sid.jmlbarang * sid.harga) - sid.jmldiskon + sid.jmlpajak1 + sid.jmlpajak2) AS total_penjualan_bersih, SUM(sid.jmldiskon) AS total_diskon FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m5_si_detail sid ON sid.idsi = si.siid AND sid.isclose = 0 WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si.sicustomer ) inv ON inv.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT si.sicustomer AS customer_id, SUM(sic.jumlah) AS total_biaya_invoice FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m5_si_cost sic ON sic.idsi = si.siid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si.sicustomer ) cost ON cost.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, SUM(sr.srtotaltransaksi) AS total_retur FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY sr.srcustomer ) ret ON ret.customer_id = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 ORDER BY margin_bersih DESC, c.knama ASC LIMIT 100

debug_info.intent_user: User meminta dashboard customer berisiko berdasarkan kombinasi beberapa dimensi: outstanding piutang invoice penjualan, aging piutang, retur penjualan, kecepatan collection/pelunasan, dan kemacetan fulfillment dokumen penjualan.
debug_info.reasoning: Permintaan ini wajib mode dashboard karena menggabungkan beberapa blok analitik berbeda: ranking customer risk, analitik aging/collection, dan fulfillment bottleneck. Untuk outstanding dan aging, tabel utama yang paling tepat adalah m5_si karena sesuai pedoman 'penjualan' default berarti invoice penjualan, serta tersedia nilai transaksi, jumlah bayar, tanggal invoice, jatuh tempo, dan status lunas. Join ke m1_contact dipakai untuk nama customer, sambil menerapkan always_apply_filters m5_si.siisclose = 0 dan m1_contact.kaktif = 1. Untuk retur tinggi dipakai m5_sr pada level header karena user meminta risk per customer, bukan per item; nilai retur diukur dari srtotaltransaksi. Untuk collection lambat dipakai agregasi tanggal invoice SI terhadap tanggal PV sebagai proxy pelunasan/collection; relasi eksplisit langsung dari SI ke PV detail tidak tersedia aman tanpa polymorphic detail, jadi dipakai customer-level earliest/latest behavior yang tetap berbasis schema valid: invoice dan payment voucher dikelompokkan per customer. Untuk fulfillment macet dipakai m5_so dan m5_cl. m5_so memberi total order dan status realisasi, sedangkan m5_cl menyimpan status lintas tahap PI/PL/DO/DR/SI/RNR/SR pada level closing sales yang memang ditujukan untuk memantau progres lanjutan penjualan. Query pertama membangun skor risiko customer secara heuristik dengan komponen outstanding, overdue aging, retur, collection lag berbasis gap rata-rata tanggal SI ke PV per customer, dan backlog fulfillment dari SO yang belum selesai. Query kedua memfokuskan distribusi aging + collection speed agar user bisa melihat customer mana yang piutangnya tua dan collection-nya lambat. Query ketiga memfokuskan bottleneck fulfillment lintas tahap menggunakan CL, menghitung jumlah baris yang belum selesai di tiap stage per customer. Semua query tetap read-only SELECT, tanpa window function, dan kompatibel MySQL/MariaDB.
